join hortbot 2 foobar 1

handle hortbot foobar/1 foobar/1 :!quote add "This is a test."
send_any

handle hortbot foobar/1 foobar/1 :!quote add "This is a test, part 2."
send_any

handle hortbot foobar/1 foobar/1 :!quote add "This is a test, part 3."
send_any


handle hortbot foobar/1 foobar/1 :!quote remove 2
send hortbot #foobar [HB] Quote #2 has been deleted.


handle hortbot foobar/1 foobar/1 :!quote edit 2 "Quote two electric boogaloo"
send hortbot #foobar [HB] "Quote two electric boogaloo" added as quote #2.

handle hortbot foobar/1 foobar/1 :!quote get 2
send hortbot #foobar [HB] Quote #2: "Quote two electric boogaloo"


handle hortbot foobar/1 foobar/1 :!quote edit -1 "This is bad."
send hortbot #foobar [HB] Quote number cannot be less than one.

handle hortbot foobar/1 foobar/1 :!quote edit 999 "This is bad."
send hortbot #foobar [HB] Quote #999 does not exist.
